design.goal: Recover a measured-forecast hold only after new complete empty planar sweeps and synchronous stopped measured motion.
design.input_contract: One explicit Clear, Return(point index), or Unavailable status for every commanded ray; return indices bind the original measured points. Missing or partial acquisition cannot certify emptiness.

resolution.model: Opaque circular external geometry intersecting the planar sensing layer; no physical shape/future-motion guarantee.

qualification.scope: Only capture/policy fields change; original worlds, forecast budgets, goals and gates remain.

gates.unchanged: Original world, sensors/noise, future error budgets, source goals/deadlines, physical clearance, road, accuracy and coverage gates

validation_refinement.reason: The new native acquisition test used 0.4 s, below the existing minimum scenario duration; use 1 s without changing physical qualification inputs or runtime statements.

limitations: Empty unannotated points do not provide negative sensing; actual complete ray outcomes and declared calibration are required.
Angular resolution uses an ideal external opaque circular-body model intersecting the sensing plane, not calibrated real-world detection or physical body coverage.
Absence confirmation requires current synchronous scan and motion stamps, measured speed at most 0.2 m/s and healthy upstream sensing/localization.
Positive and negative confirmation windows cannot mix; ordinary predictions/planner duties/independent faults are retained after monitor release.
All 28 physical forecast-coverage failures and eight original incomplete mission conditions remain scored; strict qualification is still 0/32.
One inherited forecast-coverage regression against the earlier standalone enclosure baseline remains failed.
Twenty preceding configurations without declared forecast envelopes remain outside this supported cohort.
All 42 enabled brake intervals remain censored for the older sustained-hold allowance; a separately labeled post-hoc audit observes 0 m/s at all eleven empty-sweep releases.
Recorded ticks/rays are correlated samples from authored simulation conditions; independent measured sensing, real-time, vehicle and remote/platform qualification remain open.
The subjective 30 percent waypoint and default adoption remain unmet; the option stays off.
